svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: a sparse shopper-by-product grid gains rows of synthetic shoppers
svg.title: Animated diagram: a sparse shopper-by-product grid gains rows of synthetic shoppers
svg.text: New stores have almost no history. Polanyi adds it.
Each row is a shopper, each column a product. A filled cell means “this shopper interacted with this product.”
no data: the model has to guess
